what: The fix for review-server-and-checks-01 covers only half of what it asked for: GitHub now runs the build's last commit, but the automated checks on this computer still do not. When GitHub's run is red twice, when the push or the draft pull request cannot be made, or when the hand-over page refuses the build's notes, the build is told to add a note and commit (and push and wait for GitHub) but not to run the checks again, so the owner's page still says the build's last commit is not shown to pass the automated checks, because they ran on the commit before. The finding named both halves: the page saying GitHub had not run the last commit, and the page saying the local checks ran on an earlier commit. The cause is that step 9 runs the full checks once, before the push, and the three later paths that commit again do not send the build back to that run; only the path for a first red run on GitHub does.
